real_use_case: Establish stable human-gene identity for E1A using HGNC IDs while treating approved symbols and names as mutable display/search metadata.
upstream_status: HGNC approved and withdrawn datasets pinned from the 2026-09-18 upstream snapshot by exact SHA-256 and size.
license: HGNC data are published under Creative Commons Zero (CC0); the project implementation is independent and no HGNC data bytes are redistributed in the repository.
supported_profile: Human gene identity resolution by exact HGNC ID, exact approved symbol, unique previous symbol, or unique alias symbol against the pinned HGNC snapshot.
resource_budget: Approximately 16.9 MB approved TSV plus 0.26 MB withdrawn TSV; deterministic in-memory parse/index with no network or subprocess during trusted execution.
output_contract: GeneIdentityResult with canonical HGNC ID, approved symbol/name metadata, resolution basis, pinned resource identity, and withdrawn/replacement lifecycle provenance.
known_issues: No variant-to-gene interval mapping, transcript/MANE selection, molecular consequence, HGVS projection, evidence federation, or clinical interpretation is performed. Ambiguous aliases fail closed.
security: Pinned resource digest and size verification, closed source/BOM contract, strict TSV structure validation, bounded query length, deterministic parsing, no network, no subprocess, and no dynamic code execution.
disable_path: This capability is not wired to a default execution pipeline; refuse execution unless the exact promoted HGNC approved and withdrawn snapshot identities and metadata contract validate.
